result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the system home indicator overlaps the bottom navigation bar icons.

issues.description: The OS home indicator bar at the bottom of the screen overlaps directly with the middle icons (Search and Orders) in the bottom navigation bar due to missing safe-area bottom padding.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the bottom navigation bar using safe-area insets (e.g., env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) so the navigation icons sit cleanly above the system home indicator.
